marta: Onboarding Zephyr-13B for prod. Need perf + quant plan and a small checklist. Anyone want to pick this up? :wave:
jon: I can drive. Proposed experiments: FP16 baseline, GPTQ int4, AWQ int4, NF4 int8. Throughput/latency runs + cxlen sweep. Who's on eval harness? :+1:
sasha: I'll own the evals. Plan: 500-prompt suite (dialog, code, math, QA). We need embedding-sim and a few task EM checks. Set regression thresholds before quant runs.
lee: Quick infra note — priority GPUs: p4d-prod-1 (A100 80GB) for baselines, then cheaper nodes for larger batches. Memory will bound batch/cxlen combos.
marta: Checklist (quick):
- verify tokenizer parity vs repo model
- reproduce log-likelihood on 20 golden prompts (FP16)
- KV cache memory profile export
- run p50/p95 latency at batch=1/4/16 for cxlen=512,2048,8192
- cxlen sweep to 65536 for long-context sanity
- run quant recipes: GPTQ(AUTO), AWQ, NF4-int8
- quality regressions on eval set (embedding cos, EM/BLEU)
I'll add commands below.
marta: ```
# perf runner (example)
run_perf --model zephyr-13b --mode baseline --dtype fp16 --batch-sizes 1,4,16 --cxlens 512,2048,8192 --out /runs/zephyr/1769004567/fp16.log
run_perf --model zephyr-13b --quant gptq --gptq-group 128 --batch-sizes 1,4,16 --cxlens 512,2048,8192 --out /runs/zephyr/1769004567/gptq-int4.log
```
perf-bot: perf job 1769004570 queued (priority: high) :rocket:
jon: Note for GPTQ: use 'gptq-fast' recipe with group_size=128. If OOM, switch to blockwise dequant or drop batch. For AWQ try symmetric quant params.
sasha: Quality checks to add: normalize whitespace + punctuation, then compute cosine(emb_fp16, emb_quant) per example. Flag if mean cosine < 0.95 or >3% examples drop EM. Also track hallucination heuristics (dates/entities).
lee: I'll provision a dedicated slot on Dedicated pool for the int4 runs, ETA ~2h. Will post node id when ready.
jon: SLO target: for short context (cxlen=512) batch=1 aim p50 < 80ms, p95 < 200ms. If quantized model doesn't meet that but reduces cost significantly, we may enable it behind a canary route.
marta: If int4 passes perf but quality regresses >3% relative to FP16 we'll fallback to nf4-int8 for the default route and reserve int4 for burst capacity.
jon: Run summary template (what to capture): throughput (tokens/s), p50/p95 latency, mem-peak, peak-gpu-util, token-cost-estimate, quality-metrics (embed-cosine, BLEU, EM), diff-logs for top mismatches.
sasha: I'll prep eval harness and add 3 hard failure cases to watch: date hallucination, math precision, code truncation in long contexts.
jon: Starting FP16 baseline run now. Logs will be at /runs/zephyr/1769004567/fp16.log :thumbsup:
perf-bot: job 1769004600 started on p4d-prod-1
marta: Good. Once we have FP16 baseline and KV mem profile we can pick initial batch/cxlen grid for quant runs. Reconvene after int4 results. :eyes:
